scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: Requests on rails
scenes.caption: Reva and Nikhil build a paper railway for fictional club requests. Each carries a score and checked label: routine or review. Their toy model copies the nearest selected training score’s label. No private messages are involved.
scenes.speech: Reva and Nikhil build a paper railway for fictional club requests. Each carries a score and checked label: routine or review. Their toy model copies the nearest selected training score’s label. No private messages are involved.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: 4 training anchors
scenes.caption: Training anchors are 0 routine, 4 review, 8 routine and 12 review. Visible validation checks use 1, 5, 9 and 11. Selecting every anchor predicts all 4 labels correctly. These checks guide selection; they are development evidence.
scenes.speech: Training anchors are 0 routine, 4 review, 8 routine and 12 review. Visible validation checks use 1, 5, 9 and 11. Selecting every anchor predicts all 4 labels correctly. These checks guide selection; they are development evidence.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: A difficult new score
scenes.caption: A new checked request scores 7 and needs review. Its nearest anchor, 8 routine, produces a miss. At 6, anchors 4 review and 8 routine tie; conflicting labels make this model abstain. A reviewer handles uncertainty.
scenes.speech: A new checked request scores 7 and needs review. Its nearest anchor, 8 routine, produces a miss. At 6, anchors 4 review and 8 routine tie; conflicting labels make this model abstain. A reviewer handles uncertainty.
scenes.dialogue: A tie is not a confident guess.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Define positive first
scenes.caption: Positive means needs human review. A routine request predicted review is a false alarm; a review request predicted routine is a miss. Choose whether earlier correct predictions justify automatically dismissing the new request without reading it.
scenes.speech: Positive means needs human review. A routine request predicted review is a false alarm; a review request predicted routine is a miss. Choose whether earlier correct predictions justify automatically dismissing the new request without reading it.
scenes.dialogue: The label definition fixes the error names.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Compare the review load
scenes.caption: On a fixed 5 request pack, the nearest model misses 1 review with no false alarms. Sending everything for review avoids misses but adds 2 false alarms. The teacher prioritises catching requests and can read every output.
scenes.speech: On a fixed 5 request pack, the nearest model misses 1 review with no false alarms. Sending everything for review avoids misses but adds 2 false alarms. The teacher prioritises catching requests and can read every output.
scenes.dialogue: Error costs depend on the purpose.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: An inspectable record
scenes.caption: In the lab, adjust training, count mistakes and compare settings. Reusing visible checks makes their score a validation result. After tuning, fix the selection and evaluate a separate unseen batch for independent performance evidence. Keep accountable human review.
scenes.speech: In the lab, adjust training, count mistakes and compare settings. Reusing visible checks makes their score a validation result. After tuning, fix the selection and evaluate a separate unseen batch for independent performance evidence. Keep accountable human review.
scenes.dialogue: Count, explain and keep a reviewer.
